sources.excerpt: Austen novel of manners (1813) following Elizabeth Bennet, about 20, and Mr Darcy, described as one of the two central characters. Early 19th-century English gentry estates near a small town in Hertfordshire. Marriage, wealth, class and ineffectual parents are themes. Many film and TV versions; films in 1940 and 2005.
